profile.name: USBTMC 通信组件
profile.description: 用于通过 USB Test and Measurement Class（USBTMC）协议与实验仪器通信的软件组件，并非具体物理设备。它负责封装与解析 USBTMC 报文、发送命令、接收响应以及管理底层 USB 文本通信，适合连接支持 USBTMC 的测试测量仪器。
profile.description_en: A software component for communicating with laboratory instruments over the USB Test and Measurement Class (USBTMC) protocol, rather than a specific physical device. It handles USBTMC message construction and parsing, command transmission, response reception, and low-level USB text communication for instruments that support USBTMC.
